summary: AAP installs RPM-based or container-based on RHEL, or operator-based on OpenShift; container-based is recommended for new deployments as the RPM installer is deprecated.
questions: Is the RPM installer deprecated in AAP 2.6?
Which AAP install method should I use?
What installation methods does AAP have?

answer_card.title: AAP installation methods
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Container-based** on RHEL (recommended for new deployments)
- **RPM-based** on RHEL (installer deprecated)
- **Operator-based** on OpenShift
